'''2011 Bespin Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 9 July 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Bespin Regionals.pdf]]). The PDF also holds sheets marked for the Minnesota State Championship; those are on [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 9 July 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
